name: Mini Tether USD
description: Mini Tether USD (USD) is an independently issued TRC-20 token on TRON, not the official Tether USDT. 6 decimals; initial supply 100,000,000,000. Supply is variable (owner-only mint), the owner can burn, blacklist addresses and rename the token. No proxy, tax or pause. The contract address is the only identity.
